subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of Indus Valley cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Extensive use of iron tools**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indus Valley Civilization** belongs to the **Bronze Age**.
 
• **Iron was not discovered or used** in this civilization.
 
• Tools were mainly made of **copper and bronze** (not iron).
 
• Hence, “extensive use of iron tools” is **not a feature of Indus cities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Well-planned **grid-pattern cities** (roads intersect at right angles)
 
• Houses built with **burnt (baked) bricks**
 
• Highly developed **drainage and sanitation system**
 
• Standardized weights and measures system
 
• Strong focus on **urban planning and trade**
